metadata.name: tabulated-source
metadata.description: h8c: a source driven by a data series rather than a formula, the role READ/DATA plays in Odum's BASIC listings. Twelve monthly insolation values drive a producer, and the series repeats every year. The values are illustrative, chosen to show the mechanism, and are not measurements.

_why_a_table: A sine is a model of the seasons; a table is the seasons as recorded. Odum's published simulations read their driving data from DATA statements once per pass, which is `interpolation: step`. Observed series that are better joined than held use `linear`.
_how_cycle_counts: extrapolation 'cycle' repeats the series with period times[last] - times[0] = 12 months. The last knot is the START of the next pass, so a year of monthly data is thirteen times, 0..12. Under 'step' the thirteenth value is never read; it is there to close the period.

nodes._note: Time is in months. times are ABSOLUTE model time, so a table takes no t_on.
